metadata.title: Reconstructed route geometry, Indian natural gas Common Carrier pipelines
metadata.densify_note: Parts have 2 vertices. Projecting a 2-vertex segment to EPSG:7755 draws a straight line in the projected plane, which departs from the geodesic by up to ~1.5 km near the middle of a 900 km segment. Densify along the geodesic before buffering.
